summary: Long-term commentary (written ~early 2014) arguing China's A-share market (上证) is building a multi-year bottom: the 2011-12 monthly break of the primary uptrend line, the 2012-12 monthly high-volume 破底翻, a heavy-volume support zone 1949-2269/2070, and a weekly heavy-volume high at 2270 whose breakout would start a bull leg. It argues emerging markets' early speculative highs are usually re-taken within ~10 years and compares the setup to Taiwan's 1995-96 triple bottom that was 'tested by bad news' (复征证所税) before running to 10256. Bottoms are made by bad-news tests; suits cash accumulation and periodic buying.

patterns.name_en: High-volume break-bottom reversal on the monthly chart
patterns.structure: After breaking the primary uptrend line, the index breaks a prior low and the month closes red (up) on heavy volume, reclaiming the level (上证 2012-12-31 month, low 1949.46).
patterns.entry: Long-term stabilisation signal on the reversal month; bottom confirmed when the monthly neckline ~2330 is broken, especially the prior high 2444 (底部确立信号).
patterns.stop: All conditional on not breaking the bottom support (技术面不破底部支撑); support zone 1949-2269 (monthly), 1949-2070 (daily).

target.formula: Not given numerically; long-term expectation that the 6124 speculative high is revisited/broken within ~10 years

confirmation: Heavy volume on the reversal month.
Break of monthly neckline ~2330 and prior high 2444.80.

patterns.name_zh: 大量区高点突破（爆量高点）
patterns.name_en: Breakout above the latest heavy-volume high
patterns.structure: Volume-price structure: rising above the high made on heavy volume starts a bull leg; a top formed after heavy volume following a big rise starts a bear leg. Latest heavy-volume week: 2013-09-14 high 2270.
patterns.entry: If support holds and price breaks above the heavy-volume high (2270 weekly / 2270.27 daily 天量区高点), a bull leg begins.
patterns.stop: Support zone below (double-bottom support 1849.65/1949.46; daily support 1949-2070).

target.worked_example: 2006-01-07 week breakout of the 2004-09..2005-12 base (low 998.23) -> rally to 6124.04.

confirmation: Daily: a marginal breakout of the neckline on 2013-12 failed because it did not clear the heavy-volume high 2270 and fell back below in 5 trading days (假突破).
invalidation: Falling back below the neckline after a marginal break (as in Dec 2013).

patterns.name_en: Triple bottom extended by a bad-news test (Taiwan 1995-96)
patterns.structure: An expected double bottom (预估的双底, ~5 months) is pushed down by bad news (复征证所税, gap down) into a ~3-month extension, forming a ~8-month triple bottom (lows 4474.32, 4530.96, 4672.67/4675.36) that does not break the low.
patterns.entry: 带量长红突破颈线 — long high-volume red candle breaking the neckline (6191.16 label) = bottom complete, bull signal.
patterns.stop: Not stated explicitly; implied the low 4474 must not break.
confirmation: High-volume long red candle on the neckline break.

rules.rule: A national index breaking its primary (original) uptrend line on the monthly chart is rare and leads to a long slump.
rules.quote_zh: 上证指数月线2011年12月31日当月跌破原始上升趋势线，这对于一个国家的指数来说是相当罕见的现象，也因此进入长期的低迷。

rules.rule: A monthly red, high-volume break-bottom reversal is a long-term stabilisation signal; the heavy-volume range becomes long-term support.
rules.quote_zh: 2012年12月31日当月翻红带量破底翻为技术面长线企稳信号，股价也进入一年多来的打底，大量区间1949点至2269点为月线的长线支撑区。

rules.rule: An emerging market's early speculative high is usually re-broken within 10 years (speculation first, then fundamental growth).
rules.quote_zh: 重点在一个新兴国家初期的投机高点大多会在10年内再度突破，主要是因为先走投机，再走基本面高成长的循环

rules.rule: Bottom confirmation on the monthly: neckline break near 2330, especially breaking prior high 2444; all conditional on not breaking bottom support.
rules.quote_zh: 当然这一切都必须在技术面不破底部支撑的前提之下，月线的颈线在2330点附近突破，尤其是前高2444点突破为底部确立信号

rules.rule: Volume-price structure: a new high after heavy volume is a bull leg; a topping process after heavy volume following a big rise is a bear leg. Breaking the latest heavy-volume high with support intact starts a bull leg.
rules.quote_zh: 注意量价结构上大量后的过高都是一波多头行情，反之涨多爆量后的盘头都是一波盘跌空头行情，最近一次的爆量是2013年9月14日当周的高点2270点，表示未来若支撑不破而突破2270点就是一波多头的开始

rules.rule: A marginal neckline break that fails to clear the heavy-volume high and falls back below the line within 5 trading days is not confirmed.
rules.quote_zh: 上证日线曾在2013年12月14日微幅突破颈线，可惜未突破大量区高点2270点做确立，且在五个交易日后跌落线下

rules.rule: Daily support zone is drawn from the major low and the relative consolidation range (1949-2070); if support holds and neckline breaks, the market becomes very tradeable.
rules.quote_zh: 由这个支撑及2013年7月低档震荡的相对整理区间，得以画出1949点至2070点为日线支撑区，一旦支撑不破而突破颈线，则中国大陆股市将是各路英雄大显身手的地方。

rules.rule: Bottoms are tested out by bad news; same bad news has different effects depending on structure (crash after a big rise vs. bottoming after a long decline).
rules.quote_zh: 底部都是利空测试出来的

rules.rule: For A-shares at this structure, buying with cash at the bottom and holding long-term, then periodic fixed-amount buying until the eventual blow-off, is suitable whether or not it breaks lower again.
rules.quote_zh: 无论是否会再破底，非常适合现金在底部买入长期持有，再定期定额续买至未来喷出为止

rules.rule: A weekly base breakout (2006-01-07 week) gave the technical buy signal for a multi-fold speculative run.
rules.quote_zh: 上证周线2004年9月至2005年12月约一年多的底部，在2006年1月7日当周突破出现技术面的买进信号，随后盘涨至喷出进入数倍的投机行情

worked_examples.outcome: n.a. (forecast at time of writing); 2011-12 trendline break, 2012-12 high-volume 破底翻.

worked_examples.pattern: 底部突破 / 大量区高点
worked_examples.outcome: 2006 breakout led to multi-fold rally to 6124; 2270 breakout pending at writing.

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 / 破底翻 / 支撑区
worked_examples.outcome: Dec-2013 marginal neckline break failed within 5 days (钱荒); 2/10 破底翻 above 1984.82.
High-volume long red candle broke the neckline, bottom complete; ran 1+ year to 10256.

worked_examples.pattern: 投机高点10年内再突破 analogue
worked_examples.outcome: 1988 tax news: 19-day volume-less crash after big rally; 1996 tax news: only 1 day down, low not broken.

quantifiable: Monthly trendline break: close below a trendline through the major monthly lows of a multi-year uptrend -> long-term bearish regime.
Monthly 破底翻: monthly bar makes a new low below prior swing low, closes up (red) with volume above N-month average -> long-term stabilisation flag.
Heavy-volume-high breakout: find the highest-volume week in the last N; breakout above that week's high while above support zone -> bull leg start.
Failed marginal breakout: close above neckline but below heavy-volume high, then close back below neckline within 5 bars -> invalid (false breakout).
Support zone = [major low, upper edge of nearby consolidation] (e.g., 1949-2070).
ambiguities: Monthly support zone is 1949-2269 on p227 but heavy-volume high is cited as 2270 (weekly) and 2270.27 (daily); daily support zone given as 1949-2070 — different timeframes give different zones.
Monthly neckline 'near 2330' is not drawn with a printed label; 2334.33 appears on the daily chart.
Text date '2013年12月14日' for the daily marginal breakout vs chart marker '12/4' (2260.87); possibly a typo or different events.
'10年内再度突破' vs '再来一次甚至突破' (u19a) — revisit vs. break is loose.
No mechanical stop or target; much is macro/policy narrative (钱荒, 证所税).
